# Silver Signal Partners

> Silver Signal Partners is an independent Salesforce consultancy that fixes the CRM
> and revenue systems companies already own. It is not a Salesforce reseller or a
> registered Salesforce partner, so it earns nothing from licence sales. Operated by
> Silver Signal Ltd, London, United Kingdom, working with clients in the UK, USA and
> Australia.

Engagements are scoped before they start and each one has a defined end. The firm
organises its work by the problem a client has rather than by Salesforce cloud or
industry vertical.

## Services
- [Speed to Lead](https://silversignal.ai/services/speed-to-lead): Rebuilding inbound intake in Salesforce so every lead is answered in under five minutes. Fixed scope, typically six to eight weeks.
- [Revenue Engine Build](https://silversignal.ai/services/revenue-engine-build): Full Salesforce implementation or rebuild designed around how a team already sells. Programme of three to six months.
- [Fractional CTO](https://silversignal.ai/services/fractional-cto): Retained senior technical leadership on roadmap, architecture and vendor decisions, for companies not ready to hire a full-time CTO.
- [Rescue](https://silversignal.ai/services/rescue): Fixed-scope, time-boxed intervention on a stalled or failed Salesforce implementation. Diagnose, fix, document, leave. Two to six weeks.

## Proof
- A US personal injury firm reduced time to first response from six hours to four minutes, lifted appointment conversion 38 percent against baseline, and attributed $1.2M of pipeline in the first twelve months, with no new headcount.
